retracted.what: g0_samples/g0_agree = 1186/1186 (the 2026-09-18 bb52 2D G0 vote). The ve_*/vv_* counts are G1 counts and are not retracted.
retracted.reason: The 2026-09-18 G0 used sign(min gap) (the minimum over non-VV covers) as a membership predicate for concave blocks. That rule is false in both directions: separated judged intersecting (thin-arm L block + box floating in the notch) and intersecting judged separated (wedge pressed into a channel corner); 621 of the 1186 were intersecting samples that passed on the false rule. Counterexamples pinned in tests/test_bb52_g1.py (test_g0_gate_no_false_alarm_on_thin_arm_L_notch, test_g0_gate_no_false_negative_on_wedge_in_channel, test_g0_rerun_replays_the_original_1186_translations).
